title: till-settlement/v1
description: What a payment processor, a marketplace or any system that holds a balance for a company hands TILL about the money that moved through it. A document that validates here can still be refused by the reader for these checks, which JSON Schema cannot state: currency_mismatch (the event is in another currency than the workspace); duplicate_id (another event of the same file carries this id, so which one is right is not knowable); amount_mismatch (amount is not net plus the VAT amount to the Rappen); calendar_date (day must be a real calendar date, so 2026-02-30 is refused though it has the right form); number_decimals (an amount written as a JSON number must be an exact decimal with at most two places (10.815 and 1e-3 are refused); write amounts as decimal strings to have the schema check it); text_length (the length limits count UTF-16 code units, the schema counts characters, so a name or id with characters outside the basic plane can pass the schema and be refused). Unknown extra fields are ignored at every level. Version policy: within v1 only optional fields and new kinds are added; a change to what amount, net, VAT or the sign mean, or to a required field, is v2.

source.description: Who produced the document. The pair system and processor is the key TILL keeps the booking template and the idempotency by.

system.description: The platform or system that emits the document.

processor.description: The processor or balance the events moved through.

entity.description: The company the document is about.

generatedAt.description: When the producer made the document (an ISO instant).

clearingAccount.description: The producer's label for the clearing account. TILL never books by it.

signConvention.description: A sentence saying how the sign of amount reads.

warnings.description: What the producer could not state exactly.

event.description: One movement on the processor balance.

id.description: Stable and unique per event within the source: a re-import books nothing twice.

kind.description: What the movement is. An older reader refuses an unknown kind per event.

day.description: The booking day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the company time zone, a real calendar date.

currency.description: Must be the currency of the TILL workspace.

amount.description: The signed effect on the processor balance, gross including VAT; positive means into the balance. At most two decimals.

net.description: The part of amount that is not VAT, signed like amount.

vat.description: The VAT in amount, or null when the event carries none.

amount.description: The VAT part of amount, signed like amount.

code.description: The producer's label. TILL books by the owner's template, never by this.

rate.description: The rate in percent, for the record.

document.description: The document the event belongs to, by which a PDF is linked as a Beleg.

refs.description: External references (charge, payout, order ids), kept with the event.

date.description: The ISO instant of the event.
